items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: Now that could have been Red Nichols, uh, uh, I don't think Bix had come to town that early.

ctx.x: So you don't have much of a recollection of any other real jazz in New York?

No, no. Except, uh, I was in the Academy of Music, you know, on 14th Street one day. Yeah. And I heard a jazz band that just knocked me completely unconscious. It was a knockout. Now that could have been Red Nichols, uh, uh, I don't think Bix had come to town that early.
I doubt if it was Red Nichols. I don't know who it was.
